name: Tight Kick Room
description: Small, punchy room with a short warm bloom that adds body and size to kick drums without smearing the attack.

name: Wood Room
description: Warm, wood-panelled tracking room with a rich low-mid glow; a natural all-rounder for snare and toms.

name: Live Room
description: Big, bright live room with strong early reflections for an open, exciting drum sound with real size.

name: Dead Room
description: Heavily treated small room: mostly tight early reflections that thicken close mics without an audible tail.

name: Air Room (Hats)
description: Airy, bright room with the lows removed so hi-hats, cymbals and shakers gain space without washing up the kit.

name: Studio Snare Room
description: Medium studio room voiced around the snare: crisp early reflections and a short, dense half-second tail.

name: Drum Booth
description: Very small iso-booth ambience: a tight slap of close walls that adds depth to dry close mics.

name: Stone Room
description: Hard stone room with a long, bright and dense decay for big, roomy snares and tom fills.

name: Garage
description: Concrete garage with boxy low mids and a hard, reflective character for lo-fi and garage-rock drums.

name: Medium Plate
description: Classic medium steel plate: dense, smooth and bright - the go-to reverb for snare and toms.

name: Bright Snare Plate
description: Short, sizzling plate with an extended top end that makes snares crack and sit forward in the mix.

name: Short Plate
description: Tight plate with a sub-second decay for busy grooves and fast fills where a long tail would clutter.

name: Long Plate
description: Lush, long plate for ballad snares, sparse tom hits and dramatic accents.

name: Dark Plate
description: Warm, darker plate with heavy damping that thickens toms and kicks without hiss or splash.

name: Rim Chamber
description: Small, bright tiled chamber that gives rimshots and cross-stick an articulate, woody ring.

name: Echo Chamber
description: Classic studio echo chamber: smooth, dense and mid-forward - the sound of '60s and '70s snare records.

name: Small Chamber
description: Compact concrete chamber with a dense, slightly boxy one-second tail that glues snare and toms together.

name: Tom Hall
description: Warm medium hall with extra low-end sustain that makes toms and floor toms roll and bloom.

name: Large Hall
description: Large concert hall with a long, smooth decay for epic snares, big tom fills and cinematic percussion.

name: Medium Hall
description: Medium hall with a balanced, smooth two-second decay - a versatile snare and percussion reverb.

name: Bright Hall
description: Bright, modern hall with extended high-frequency decay that adds sparkle and air to snares and cymbals.

name: Perc Spring
description: Short, twangy spring tank that adds vintage drip and bounce to percussion and snares.

name: Twin Spring
description: Classic amp-style twin spring tank with a long, boingy decay for surf drums and dub snares.

name: Tight Spring
description: Damped, short spring for subtle drip on rimshots, bongos and lo-fi breaks.

name: Vintage Digital Room
description: Late-'80s digital room: grainy, chorused and band-limited - instant classic-record drum ambience.

name: Vintage Digital Plate
description: Glassy late-'80s digital plate with chorused shimmer and a 12 kHz ceiling - big, bright '80s snares.

name: Vintage Digital Hall
description: Dark, chorused '80s digital hall with a smooth, wide tail that makes toms and snares huge and dreamy.

name: Vintage Ambience
description: Short, dense '80s digital ambience program that adds instant size and grit to drum loops and close mics.

name: Gated '80s
description: Huge compressed-and-gated room in the '80s style: a wall of ambience that slams shut at around 360 ms.

name: Reverse Non-Lin
description: Rising, backwards-sounding non-linear program that swells into a hard cut at around 320 ms.
generator: non-linear (dense FDN base, rising envelope + gate)

name: Short Gate
description: Tight, flat 220 ms gated ambience that fattens snares and claps with a punchy, modern burst.

name: Big Gated Hall
description: Enormous gated hall that holds for half a second then stops dead - stadium-sized '80s toms and snares.

name: Flat Non-Lin
description: Perfectly flat, dense non-linear burst of 280 ms with no early reflections - pure '80s machine gating.
generator: non-linear (dense FDN base, flat envelope + gate)

name: Reverse Clap Swell
description: Reversed plate that swells up after each hit and stops dead - the classic backwards snare and clap effect.

name: Bloom Cloud
description: Slow-blooming, modulated cloud that swells behind the hit and turns single snares and toms into evolving pads.

name: Metal Shimmer
description: Tuned metallic resonator wash that turns percussion into ringing, shimmering metal - great on rims and claps.
generator: metallic (tuned comb resonators + bright FDN wash)

name: Reverse Hall
description: Long reversed hall that sucks into a hard stop - big cinematic reverse tom and snare transitions.
